prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agency—the right fit depends on your parent’s needs, schedule, budget, and preferred caregiver. **I’d start by interviewing Right at Home of East Bay and Visiting Angels Livermore**, both of which serve Pleasanton and advertise personal care, companionship, and more extensive support. Right at Home lists dementia care, respite, transportation, and live-in care; Visiting Angels lists overnight and 24-hour options. **Home Instead** is another option serving Pleasanton, though its local office is in Union City.

- [Right at Home of East Bay](https://www.rightathome.net/pleasanton/about-us/areas-served/pleasanton) — (925) 401-5261  
- [Visiting Angels Livermore](https://www.visitingangels.com/livermore/home-care-pleastanton) — (925) 443-1000  
- [Home Instead serving Pleasanton](https://www.homeinstead.com/home-care/usa/ca/fremont/291/service-area/home-care-in-pleasanton-ca/) — (510) 972-0870  

Before choosing, ask each agency for a written care plan and full cost estimate, whether it can reliably cover your needed hours, how it handles caregiver absences, and whether it has experience with your parent’s specific needs. Check its California Home Care Organization license and ask about caregiver screening, training, supervision, insurance, and references. If your parent needs **skilled nursing or therapy**, ask their doctor about a Medicare-certified home health agency; that’s different from non-medical home care.
